name: One-on-One Meeting
description: Manager and direct report check-in focused on priorities, feedback, blockers, and growth.

sections.title: Meeting Metadata
sections.instruction: Date, participants, meeting cadence, and whether this is a recurring or ad hoc check-in

sections.title: Current Priorities
sections.instruction: Summarize the employee's current focus areas, commitments, and important deadlines

sections.title: Wins & Progress
sections.instruction: Capture accomplishments, positive outcomes, and progress since the previous one-on-one

sections.title: Challenges & Blockers
sections.instruction: List blockers, concerns, or areas where support is needed, including impact and proposed help

sections.title: Feedback Exchanged
sections.instruction: Summarize feedback given by either participant, separating observations from requested changes

sections.title: Growth & Development
sections.instruction: Capture development goals, coaching topics, career interests, or learning opportunities discussed

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List follow-up tasks with owners and due dates
